newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI MEDIA 1996 PROFIT UP TO FIM 132 MLN.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI MEDIA 1996 PROFIT UP TO FIM 132 MLN.

text.p: Finnish media house ~Helsinki Media~ said in a statement on Monday its pre-tax profit rose to 131.8 million markka in 1996 from 37.2 million in 1995.
Operating profit rose to 79.4 million markka from 34.1 million and group turnover increased 7.7 percent to 1.13 billion markka.
All units reported operating profits, Helsinki Media said.
It had booked a 59 million markka gain on the sale of its 10 percent stake in commercial television company MTV.
